name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Death toll from Russia's 2 Nov strike on an aid centre in Komyshuvakha rises to 53; ballistic missiles hit Kyiv
state: The Zaporizhzhia regional administration said on 6 Nov that 53 people were killed by Russia's 2 Nov strike on a former school handing out aid in Komyshuvakha, where a second strike hit a shelter (Interfax-Ukraine; Kyiv Post). Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv overnight into 7 Nov, injuring at least three, and Ukraine struck a refinery in Saratov region (Kyiv Independent). Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi are planned.
for_you: For travel, follow FCDO advice, which warns against all travel to Ukraine.
